question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：埃及 vs 伊朗（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: Egypt vs IR Iran (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: 伊朗凭约 76 分 Elo 优势统计占先，但阿兹蒙落选削弱锋线、萨拉赫官宣可复出，埃及胜平合计接近六成，三路皆无明显把握。
one_liner_en: Iran's ~76-point Elo edge makes them the statistical front-runner, but Azmoun's omission thins their attack while Salah is officially expected back fit; Egypt's win-or-draw probability is close to 60% and no outcome is clear-cut.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 76 分：伊朗 1772（第 29）vs 埃及 1696（第 48），Davidson 模型基线给伊朗约 45% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: 76-point Elo gap: Iran 1772 (rank 29) vs Egypt 1696 (rank 48); the Davidson baseline gives Iran ~45% to win.

key_reasons.cn: 阿兹蒙（91 场 57 球）完全落选伊朗 26 人名单，锋线深度受损，仅剩塔雷米领衔的五人锋线。
key_reasons.en: Azmoun (57 goals in 91 caps) was fully omitted from Iran's 26-man squad, thinning the attack to a five-man front line led by Taremi.

key_reasons.cn: 萨拉赫 4 月底腿筋撕裂，埃及官方称约 4 周治疗后可赶上世界杯；至本场第三轮已有约两个月恢复窗口。
key_reasons.en: Salah tore a hamstring in late April; Egyptian officials said ~4 weeks of treatment and confirmed he would be fit for the World Cup, giving him ~2 months of recovery before this matchday-3 fixture.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat = 0.292/0.255/0.453; bounded evidence adjustment (net ~2pp from Iran toward Egypt/draw: Azmoun omission, Salah confirmed fit) -> p_final = 0.303/0.265/0.432. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and matchday-3 stakes uncertainty. No market inputs of any kind.
